notes: Headline traits cover every catalog short; media features only shorts with media extracted; speech timing only caption and Whisper transcripts (the transcript API's word times are word indices).
Text overlay is OCR at one frame a second, words of 2+ alphanumerics at confidence 60+.
Not measured: emotion, music detection as such (speechShare is the speech-versus-other-sound balance over audible seconds).

features.durationSec: length in seconds (the media file; the catalog where no media)
features.cutsPerSec: scene cuts per second (a local peak of the ffmpeg scene score, at least 0.1 and 5x the short's median)
features.firstCutSec: seconds to the first cut (the duration when there is none)
features.visualActivity: mean frame-to-frame scene score (motion and change)
features.hookLoudnessDelta: loudness of the first 2 s minus the whole short's, LU
features.textWordsPerFrame: on-screen words per sampled frame (OCR, 1 frame a second)
features.textFrameShare: share of sampled frames carrying on-screen text (2+ words)
features.textHook: on-screen words in the first 2 s of frames
features.speechWps: spoken words per second between the first and last word
features.firstWordSec: seconds to the first spoken word
features.wordsHook: spoken words in the first 2 s
features.speechShare: share of audible seconds carrying speech
features.titleCapsRun: longest run of all-caps words of 3+ letters in the title
